result.topic_en: Hilbert approximates successive zigzag (polygonal) lines by polynomials G_1, G_2, ... to build a telescoping series for a function, notes that the Weierstrass approximation theorem can be derived from this (citing Runge, Acta Math. 7), and gives the function f(p/q)=1/q (0 at irrationals) as another example expandable by his theorem.

items.english: From this, in particular, Weierstrass's theorem on the uniformly convergent expansion of continuous functions can be derived; compare Runge, Acta Math. 7, p. 387.

items.quote:
Ein
anderes Beispiel für eine nach meinem
Satze entwickelbare Funktion ist [-d-] die Funktion
$f(\frac{p}{q}) = \frac{1}{q}$ und $f(x)$ für irrationale $x = 0$,
welche eine überall dichte Menge von
Unstetigkeitsstellen besitzt.
items.english: Another example of a function expandable by my theorem is the function f(p/q) = 1/q and f(x) = 0 for irrational x, which has an everywhere dense set of points of discontinuity.
